MastinJailletChin2014RandomizedRegret supplies the finite-game LP duality; the observable categorical-IV specialization is useful supporting material.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 — thm:unique-face-rootn
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The Gaussian and Hadamard-differentiability claims are conditional on the observable fixed-support, response-basis, active-face, rank, slack, and complementarity margins defining P_{kappa,epsilon}; face intersections are excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The moving-coefficient uniform asymptotic law holds on P_{kappa,epsilon}, not at arbitrary categorical-IV laws or optimal-face intersections.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 — oeq:face-intersection-contraction
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The proposal does not assume a directional-inference solution at face intersections; it supplies an explicit adjacent-basis/Fang--Santos handle as the unresolved construction route.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-sample correspondence coverage remains claimed at ties, while uniform contracting root-n inference at intersections remains open.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a categorical-IV compatible joint-potential-outcome characterization, sharp causal-functional bounds, and simultaneous finite-sample confidence intervals for linear functionals.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.1, equations (8)-(9), Proposition 3.1, and Section 4.1, equations (12)-(15)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper forms a deterministic categorical action by minimizing an interval-endpoint worst-case loss; its softmax weights are a surrogate-learning device for that deterministic induced rule, not a joint response-polytope randomized minimax policy.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2007.13473, corresponding preprint for the 2022 Annals of Operations Research article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The LP considered has a randomly perturbed right-hand-side vector and the paper derives degeneracy-sensitive optimizer and value limits plus optimal-set Hausdorff rates.
The paper gives auxiliary-LP formulas for limits and asymptotically valid confidence sets for random-LP solution and full optimal-solution sets.

The paper studies local sequences around least-favorable reduced-form configurations and a limiting normal location-shift decision problem, rather than fixed-law categorical-IV optimizer-map inference.
The paper studies statistical treatment rules with many treatments, asymptotic minimax-regret optimality of an empirical-success rule, and balanced versus unbalanced designs.
Theorem 5.1 gives the binary randomized treatment probability formed from lower and upper treatment-effect bounds and its regret guarantee.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a finite, checkable criterion or algorithm for the projective-normal diagnostic omega_x>0, including its computational complexity, so the fixed-matrix obstruction is independently usable rather than only existential.

Turn the exact three-action separation into a generic nonrectangularity theorem: give an observable open family of categorical-IV tables on which the joint and rectangle rules differ, with the displayed rational witness as one member.

State a boundary corollary that identifies the precise additional condition under which the rectangle oracle is lossless, separating the definition-driven certificates from a structural categorical-IV characterization.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with Theorem 1 as the field-tier kernel; first formalize the active-face stability and independently source-check Stoye Proposition 1 before relying on the exact sanity-reduction formula.
